changelog: Added a Masterminds achievement request after checking all three Doomsday Masterminds award flags, with GTA confirmation or pending status.
Added 10th Anniversary weapon finishes, Bottom Dollar clothing and masks, and Benny's conversion access under More Unlocks in both interfaces.
Added separate Contract, Arena War, Arcade, Drug Wars, and Daily Objective Medals award actions using current game receivers.
Added Complete Today's Daily Objectives, which uses GTA's objective queue and checks live and saved completion flags; daily medals remain a separate action.
Added Verify New Unlock Status to check unlock flags and award counters, with missing receivers logged and a compact result popup.
Fixed Time Played edits above roughly 596 hours and fixed the mouse UI covering the number-entry box; the menu returns after entering or canceling a value.
Added spaced cyan [NEW] badges in both interfaces. Only the latest additions keep the badge; older markers are removed on the next feature update.
Changed View Changelog to a centered, scrollable window that stays open until closed with Close, X, an outside click, Esc, or controller A/B.
Fixed portable blue nebula loading on installations without local animation files, rejected undecoded textures, and added retries for failed image loads.
Added blue nebula video playback to the mouse UI, including built-in animation frames for updates.
Added blurred control and section backgrounds, black star hover effects, and matching sidebar highlights.
Fixed six reproduced Lua issues in heist lookups, audit output, diagnostics, imports, and protection error reporting.
Preserved model-guard quarantine; live protection crashes remain under investigation.
